scope: Saved test set only; dev metrics remain literal and are not presented as reviewed.
method: Literal evidence OR documented equivalent evidence within one source-traceable chunk; never union of chunks.
reviewer: Codex (AI assistant), deriving retrieval decisions from student-confirmed audit

label_provenance.method: Read displayed chunks and top-3 traces; compare with PDF text, gold and rubric; explicit reasons below. Not a human or independent blinded review.
label_provenance.bias_risk: Same assistant supported benchmark/code/report and reviewed outputs after seeing retrieval scores.

decisions.equivalent_evidence_quote: Workers with higher reputation scores and greater experience tend to receive more work, as clients prefer to engage with those perceived as more reliable. Consequently, this phenomenon results in an unequal distribution of opportunities, disadvantaging workers with lower scores and less experience.
